create_TaskSpec: create a TaskSpec with a code statement, setup code, and optional label for benchmarking
build_Measurement: build a Measurement from raw timing values and a TaskSpec to compute median, mean, and IQR statistics
merge_Measurements: merge multiple Measurement objects with the same TaskSpec into a single combined Measurement
run_trim_sigfig: run trim_sigfig to round a float value to a specified number of significant figures
test_set_torch_threads: test set_torch_threads context manager to temporarily set torch thread count with automatic restoration
